python3 -c "
import cv2, numpy as np

img28 = cv2.imread('/work/observations/obs_0028.png')
# Camera at (-0.5, 3.3), heading 270 (-x).
# In obs 28, table is directly ahead!
# Let's inspect the table legs in obs 28:
# Table leg 1 (left):
# Table leg 2 (right):
# Table leg 3 (back left):
# Table leg 4 (back right):

# Find wood pixels:
mask_wood = (img28[:,:,2] > 80) & (img28[:,:,2] < 150) & (img28[:,:,1] > 35) & (img28[:,:,1] < 80) & (img28[:,:,0] < 50)
# Table is between x=220 and x=430
ys_t, xs_t = np.where(mask_wood & (np.arange(512)[None,:] > 200) & (np.arange(512)[None,:] < 450))
print('Table x range in obs 28:', xs_t.min(), xs_t.max(), 'center x:', xs_t.mean())

# Front two legs bottom y:
# Left front leg: x around 230..260
# Right front leg: x around 380..415
ys_fl, xs_fl = np.where(mask_wood & (np.arange(512)[None,:] > 230) & (np.arange(512)[None,:] < 260))
ys_fr, xs_fr = np.where(mask_wood & (np.arange(512)[None,:] > 380) & (np.arange(512)[None,:] < 415))
print('Left front leg bottom y:', ys_fl.max(), 'center x:', xs_fl.mean())
print('Right front leg bottom y:', ys_fr.max(), 'center x:', xs_fr.mean())

# Back legs:
# Back right leg: x around 355..380
ys_br, xs_br = np.where(mask_wood & (np.arange(512)[None,:] > 355) & (np.arange(512)[None,:] < 380) & (np.arange(512)[:,None] > 370))
print('Back right leg bottom y:', ys_br.max(), 'center x:', xs_br.mean())

# Distance to front legs:
d_front = 256 * 1.55 / (ys_fl.max() - 255.5)
d_back = 256 * 1.55 / (ys_br.max() - 255.5)
print(f'd_front = {d_front:.2f} m, d_back = {d_back:.2f} m')
x_front = -0.5 - d_front
x_back = -0.5 - d_back
x_center = (x_front + x_back) / 2
print(f'x_front = {x_front:.2f}, x_back = {x_back:.2f}, x_center = {x_center:.2f}')

# Lateral y:
# Left front leg y:
y_fl = 3.3 + (xs_fl.mean() - 255.5)/256 * d_front
y_fr = 3.3 + (xs_fr.mean() - 255.5)/256 * d_front
print(f'y_fl = {y_fl:.2f}, y_fr = {y_fr:.2f}, y_center = {(y_fl + y_fr)/2:.2f}')
"
